basic_info.description: Exclusive Financing Offers Available! This newly constructed, ultra-efficient studio-style home is thoughtfully designed to maximize space and functionality. The sleek, modern kitchen features high ceilings that enhance the open feel and allow for abundant natural light. A well-appointed bathroom offers ample storage, adding to the home's smart design.    Residents enjoy a comprehensive amenity package, including a pet washing station, bicycle storage, fitness center, community lounge, and a central courtyard with plenty of seating. The Master Plan also boasts parks, public art installations, pocket parks, walking paths, and more.    Each home is outfitted with upgraded flooring, quartz countertops, contemporary cabinetry, and a premium S/S GE appliance package, including a range, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, and in-unit washer/dryer. Photos showcase our model home.
